issue_147_analysis.root_cause: checkDoseRule in Check.fs: (1) G-Standard for paracetamol oral has no quantityAdjustNorm (uses daily totals), so QuantityAdjust check is skipped; (2) dl.genForm.PerTimeAdjust is empty (spreadsheet only has MinQtyAdj/MaxQtyAdj, not PerTimeAdj), so PerTimeAdjust check is also skipped; (3) implied PerTimeAdjust = QtyAdj x Freq (1500 mg/kg x 4/day = 6000 mg/kg/day) is never derived or checked
issue_147_analysis.fix: In checkDoseRule, when PerTimeAdjust is empty but QuantityAdjust is set and frequencies are available, derive implied PerTimeAdjust and check against gstand.perTimeAdjustNorm/Abs
